original_requirement: Close the four authority-critical Strict L3 defects, finish bounded Draft repair ownership, and prove the complete trustworthy Full Short offline readiness chain without executing a real Provider or Full Short.
operational_definition: All supported Planning output topologies must enter one typed finding and global-closure authority; Draft repair must consume only validator-origin exact owned findings; selected style/reference authority must remain immutable across every later stage; fidelity claims must be typed and evidence-bounded; valid unseen structures must cross the next authoritative boundary while ambiguous, malformed, capacity-limited, or interrupted inputs fail closed.
forbidden_narrowing: Do not authorize findings merely because a caller recomputed a public SHA.
Do not restrict graph safety to root-reachable components or coerce malformed identities.
Do not map a local Draft finding into a free-form or whole-draft rewrite.
Do not treat selected-to-missing style state as absence of a comparison.
Do not replace structural fidelity semantics with one observed phrase blacklist.
Do not support only the observed outline depth, language, wrapper name, Provider, story, or fixture.

constraint_traceability.requirement: Planning findings use a closed reason/code/scope registry and exact validator-origin authorization.
constraint_traceability.implementation: src/novel_flywheel/planning_semantics.py validates the exact finding schema, registry relation, canonical identity, source binding, batch HMAC and duplicate policy.
constraint_traceability.evidence: Unknown or retargeted rehashed findings, stale hashes, duplicate identities, signature replay and wrong-source batches fail closed; every registered kind is deterministic.

constraint_traceability.requirement: Global Planning closure uses strict identities, explicit bounds and whole-graph cycle detection.
constraint_traceability.implementation: src/novel_flywheel/planning_closure.py validates exact IDs and the complete declared graph before root selection under node, edge, root and serialized-byte limits.
constraint_traceability.evidence: Missing targets, duplicate edges, self-loops, disconnected cycles, non-string IDs and every resource bound are tested with deterministic closure replay.

constraint_traceability.requirement: Typed Planning authority must retain exact nested outline event ownership across public and formal projections.
constraint_traceability.implementation: src/novel_flywheel/outlines.py retains exact H2-H6 source hierarchy, rejects malformed/dual source-level states and makes public, formal, project and workflow projections agree.
constraint_traceability.evidence: Chinese H5, English H6, sparse generic containers, malformed scalar values and alias conflicts have stable regression coverage.

constraint_traceability.requirement: Draft local repair authority is exact, narrow, deterministic and cannot be forged or replayed.
constraint_traceability.implementation: src/novel_flywheel/prose_quality.py emits source-bound HMAC validator decisions; src/novel_flywheel/workflows.py admits only exact DraftRetryFindingBatch capabilities and byte-preserving owned repairs.
constraint_traceability.evidence: Multiple independent defects remain local, ambiguous/wide scope is typed or fail-closed, forged and cross-draft findings are rejected, and unowned bytes remain exact.

constraint_traceability.requirement: Frozen style/reference authority compares selected, missing, unreadable and not-requested states at every applicable stage.
constraint_traceability.implementation: src/novel_flywheel/style_context.py creates an exact byte-bound authority; src/novel_flywheel/workflows.py freezes it once and revalidates every later stage including present-to-missing transitions.
constraint_traceability.evidence: Removal, replacement, version/hash/scope/project drift, CRLF/empty/unreadable profiles and tampered in-memory profile text are covered.

constraint_traceability.requirement: Final Review fidelity language is typed, provenance-bound and bounded without blocking ordinary prose critique.
constraint_traceability.implementation: src/novel_flywheel/style_context.py scans the closed typed verdict structure, rejects author/style imitation assertions and emits only StyleReferenceFidelityClaimV1 evidence-bounded claims.
constraint_traceability.evidence: Paraphrased replication, key/value and direct-sibling constructions fail; ordinary prose, source and authorship critique pass; large verdicts remain bounded and deterministic.
